title: Scaling a Reciprocal through Composition
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Using $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{x}$ together with $g(x)=2x+1$, find $(g\circ f)(x)$ as a simplified expression and give its domain restriction.

steps.title: Compose in the Given Order
steps.explanation: Now the reciprocal rule runs first, and its output is doubled and shifted by $g(u)=2u+1$.
steps.why: Reading the composition from the inside out prevents swapping the two functions.

steps.title: Substitute the Reciprocal
steps.why: Multiplying $1/x$ by $2$ scales the reciprocal cleanly.

steps.title: Locate the Failure Point
steps.explanation: The chain stops when $f(x)=1/x$ is undefined, which happens exactly at $x=0$; every other real input works.
steps.why: Inputs rejected by the inner function are automatically rejected by the composite.
